unmeasured_terms.name: 3D-NLTE network accuracy
unmeasured_terms.source: vendor/1L-3NErrors/README.md: the authors state they "cannot supply errors as such" for the network's own abundance corrections. Amarsi, Liljegren & Nissen 2022 (A&A 668 A68) publish no per-line accuracy we can read off, and nothing we hold measures the MLP against the 3D non-LTE calculations it was trained on -- so this term is UNMEASURED, not zero (RYA-907).
